findings.decision: native x-compactness objection rejected; product-slab clarification prepared
findings.reason: In normal form projection(x,y)=(x,g(x,y)), convergence of target images forces x_j→x directly. Infinite-dimensional compactness of x is neither asserted nor needed. A closed product B×Q contained in the chart plus a closed inner target ball makes the actual critical image closed; finite-dimensional compactness of Q and closed rank-deficiency then suffice. Finite Sard on each fixed x slice proves empty interior. Countable chart products give the required exclusions. The proposal makes these missing closure margins explicit without changing the selection lemma Statement.

findings.decision: HELD at exact pointwise weak-choice binding, Statement preserved
findings.reason: The corrected selector proves only a conditional selection result, assuming actual pointwise Fredholm/Sard/compactness/gluing constructions. A conventional published Floer theorem in ZFC does not supply an audited ZF+AComega implementation. No proof here weakens the broader fullAC construction; no source found in the bounded exact read explicitly states the needed weak-choice foundation.

F5 gives explicit open collar enlargements and deformation retractions for spherical gluings, disjoint from U. Proof1.1,1.2,2.2 then apply MV only to genuine relative-open covers. The homology/irreducibility counterexample calculations and fullAC Statement are unchanged.

choice_boundary.what_is_earned: Fixed finite diagrams/moves and <=2parameter families give countably many integer domains/corners and separable Sobolev/perturbation charts. Conditional on pointwise analytic constructions, countable chart selections, closed-slab finite Sard exclusions, least-index nested balls, countable compactness extractions and explicit contraction/gluing selections are within the existing selector contract.
choice_boundary.what_is_not_earned: That the pointwise analytic prerequisites themselves, at the actual incomplete sutured targets, have a full proof under ZF+AComega. The source-qualified E1 is deliberately classical fullAC, and cannot be substituted for those hypotheses in the genus theorem merely because its applications are countable.
choice_boundary.first_unread_upstream_boundary: OS math0101206 §3.2 explicitly refers actual Fredholm theory to Floer [9], Oh [25]/[26] and Floer/Hofer/Salamon [11]/[12]; the bounded source read supplies no weak-choice proof of that elliptic/Fredholm foundation. The later compactness/gluing assertions likewise import analytic foundations. Reconstructing or auditing those books/papers is beyond this bounded assignment.
choice_boundary.not_a_necessity_claim: No counterexample to the geometric theorem under Countable Choice, and no irreducible mathematical need for fullAC, is asserted. The unresolved fact is a proof/interface binding, not evidence that the stated CC theorem is false. Its strongest approved CC Statement is left untouched.
choice_boundary.general_unqualified_claims: The existing general integral supplier proofs already declare fullAC through their Facts/dependencies; E1 supplies their missing analytic input at that existing background scope. This report does not certify those unqualified Statements as choice-free theorems. If an explicit axiom premise is required at Statement level, root must reconcile that separately; no silent Statement narrowing proposed.
